messages:
marta: Quick idea — launch a "Plugin Gallery" (tiny OSS plugins + reference apps) as a developer showcase. Goal: 3 things: drive OSS contributions, get tutorial completions, capture early product interest.

devon: love it. what assets do we need? blog post, 2 tutorials (getting-started, deep-dive), 1 benchmark writeup, 1 webinar w/live demo.

ria: Webinar + benchmark is key. propose: "Build a low-latency plugin with Redwood" — show perf & cost before/after caching + quantization. Keep benchmark narrative simple: latency, tokens/sec, cost/token.

sam: audience segmentation: devs (tutorials), platform leads (benchmarks), community contributors (OSS PRs). inbound routing: tutorials -> nurture track A, benchmarks -> sales alert + invite to webinar, OSS PRs -> repo label + DevRel ping.

leo: rough blog hero copy:

"Plugin Gallery: Tiny OSS plugins that make your app smarter — demos, tutorials, and benchmarks. Try the examples, fork the repo, ship a plugin in 15 minutes."

jen: assets + owners
- blog post: devon (draft by 6/2)
- tutorials: ria + leo (code + walkthrough by 6/6)
- benchmark writeup: sam (6/8)
- webinar: ria (rehearse 6/10, live 6/12)
- design/thumbs: jen (6/4)

marta: timeline ok. add quick leadform fields: company, role, use-case, interest (hosted/dedicated/private), opt-in to early demo. map to HubSpot tag: "plugin-gallery-2025". say yes/no to sales followup.

devon: sample tweet + CTAs:
"We built a Plugin Gallery for @redwood_inference — fork the examples, run a demo in <15m, see real perf gains. 🔧🚀 Sign up: https://go.redwood.ai/plugin-gallery" #opensource #mlops

ria: for benchmark narrative, include a simple table (in blog) showing
- baseline: hosted model at batch=1
- tuned: batching + KV cache + q4_0 quant
- delta: % latency drop, $/k tokens

leo: small code snippet for tutorial (JS):
```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY})
const res = await client.plugins.run('sentiment-plugin', {input: 'great product'})
console.log(res.output)
```

sam: inbound routing flow
- tutorial signups -> nurture-seq-plugins
- benchmark downloads -> SLA-tag + sales-notify if company size > 250
- PRs -> github label "plugin-gallery" + @devrel mention

jen: design notes: 3 thumbnails (hero, tutorial, benchmark), short video 90s for webinar landing. I'll make 2 variants for A/B.

marta: ok owners confirmed. next sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to review blog draft + landing. please add any must-have copy to the doc: https://docs.google.com/d/PLUGIN-GALLERY-DOC

deploy-bot: reminder: schedule webinar event created — ID 83421, landing page draft live at /plugin-gallery-draft

devon: tagging outreach — community newsletter slot for 6/9? will draft short blurb.

ria: I'll prepare demo script focusing on two plugins: embeddings-cache and structured-tool-caller. show perf numbers live.

marta: perfect. last note: let's make the OSS pitch clear — "Help us build examples and win swag" — simple contribution path + label for first-time PRs.

jen: :thumbsup:

devon: adding checklist to the campaign board now. 

marta: thanks all — let's keep comments here for blockers.
